captions.text: Night in a snowy forest under a full moon
A small orange fox called Ember
Ember finds an old brass lantern
Hoot the owl watches from a pine tree
Hoot says the lantern belongs to someone
Ember carries the lantern to a frozen lake
The lantern starts to glow blue by itself
Across the lake stands a dark lighthouse
and sets the lantern at the top
An old badger called Moss thanks Ember
The lantern was his. He is the lighthouse keeper
They light the lamp together every night
